crossRefs.note: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.”
Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not…
But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop…
I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose…
For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability…
While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy…
He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that…
For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given…
not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of…
whom he poured out on us richly, through Jesus Christ our Savior;

parallels.note: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

translations.web: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
translations.bsb: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
translations.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
translations.asv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize in water, he said unto me, Upon whomsoever thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and abiding upon him, the same is he that baptizeth in the Holy Spirit.
